title: Rockaway and the Southern Hempstead Bays
summary: Rockaway people are described in older histories with a principal settlement near what is now Rockville Centre, with others spread through southern Hempstead and islands in the bays along the south shore. This places Native life around the waterways west of Merrick and Freeport as part of a connected regional world.
address_label: Southern Hempstead bay landscape near Rockville Centre and Freeport
ancestral_territory_note: Associated with Merrick Ancestral Land at its western edge, while also recognizing neighboring Rockaway Native geography.
why_this_matters: The Rockaway and southern Hempstead bay landscape places Merrick history in relation to neighboring Native communities. Bays, islands, and waterways connected people across homelands before colonial town borders divided the map.
introduction_content: Merrick ancestral history meets Rockaway history along the western south shore, where bay travel and settlement did not follow later municipal lines.
